# Jenkins Migration Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > DevOps > Jenkins

## Overview

Plans and executes Jenkins migrations including version upgrades, plugin migration, and pipeline modernization to declarative syntax

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jenkins-migration-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jenkins-migration-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jenkins-migration-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Plan Jenkins major version upgrades
- Migrate freestyle jobs to pipeline as code
- Convert scripted to declarative pipelines
- Containerize Jenkins with proper persistence

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Jenkins Upgrade**: LTS upgrade procedures and compatibility
- **Pipeline Migration**: Converting freestyle to pipeline jobs
- **JCasC**: Configuration as Code for Jenkins
